name: Ingredients for the Forge

angles.text: Morhan Coppertongue depends on smiths and metalworkers to supply Thelsamar with everyday goods, from kettles and cooking pots to field tools.
Miners who smelt copper and tin into bronze bars provide the materials that keep Loch Modan's rural workshops working.
Even a small dwarven settlement like Thelsamar depends on its forge, so a shortage of metal concerns the whole community.

aliases: who gives ingredients for the forge
faq.answer: Morhan Coppertongue, a dwarven craftsman, offers it at the forge in Thelsamar, in Loch Modan.
faq.q: Who offers Ingredients for the Forge?

aliases: materials for ingredients for the forge
faq.answer: Morhan needs bronze bars for his workshop. He uses them to make everyday goods such as pots, kettles, and tools for local residents.
faq.q: What materials does Morhan Coppertongue need?

faq.answer: Thelsamar lacks Ironforge's great workshops and steady trade. Its craftspeople can run short of raw metal.
faq.q: Why is Thelsamar running out of metal?

aliases: what is bronze used for in thelsamar
faq.answer: Morhan uses bronze to make useful goods for the home and workplace, including cookware, kettles, pots, and tools for the townsfolk.
faq.q: What does Morhan forge with the bronze?

faq.answer: Morhan also needs a regular trader to bring coal into town. The forge depends on fuel to keep its fires burning.
faq.q: What other supplies does the forge struggle to get?

aliases: where does ingredients for the forge take place
faq.answer: It takes place in Thelsamar, Loch Modan's chief dwarven settlement in the hills east of Dun Morogh.

sections.body: Thelsamar keeps a quieter pace than Ironforge's Great Forge. Far from the capital, supplies can be hard to come by. Morhan Coppertongue, the local blacksmith, makes the hardware, pots, and tools the township needs. Yet bronze and other raw metals often run short. Without regular shipments from the city, passing travelers and prospectors help keep the local anvils at work.
sections.title: Supply Strains in Thelsamar

sections.body: Bronze bars let Morhan resume making goods for daily use. But the forge still faces shortages, and Loch Modan has no reliable merchant route bringing coal to town.
sections.title: Keeping the Fires Burning

summary: In Thelsamar, Morhan Coppertongue needs bronze bars to fill his dwindling workshop stores. Far from Ironforge's steady trade, the settlement depends on travelers to bring the metals its forge needs.
attribution: In-game quest text: Ingredients for the Forge
